name: Gary Wang

summary.text: Gary Wang co-founded the FTX cryptocurrency exchange with Sam Bankman-Fried and served as its chief technology officer. He pleaded guilty to four counts, cooperated with prosecutors and testified against Bankman-Fried. On November 20, 2024 U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan sentenced him to time served, three years of supervised release on each count and forfeiture of $11 billion, the last sentencing of the FTX executives; Wang had faced a maximum of 50 years.
